name: Paraiso rectocele repair
question: How do posterior colporrhaphy, site-specific rectocele repair, and porcine-graft-augmented site-specific repair compare for posterior vaginal wall prolapse?

arms.label: site-specific rectocele repair with porcine small-intestinal-submucosa graft

design.population: 106 women with stage II or greater posterior vaginal wall prolapse.

verdictNote: Graft augmentation had the highest one-year anatomic failure rate.
takeaway: In women with posterior vaginal wall prolapse, porcine small-intestinal-submucosa graft augmentation of site-specific repair had more one-year anatomic failures than native-tissue site-specific repair or posterior colporrhaphy; patient-reported improvements did not differ among groups.

reports.label: Primary report
reports.citation: Paraiso MFR, Barber MD, Muir TW, Walters MD. "Rectocele repair: a randomized trial of three surgical techniques including graft augmentation." *Am J Obstet Gynecol.* 2006;195(6):1762-1771. doi:10.1016/j.ajog.2006.07.026
reports.followUp: One-year anatomic assessment; mean follow-up 17.5 ± 7 months among 98 returning participants
reports.followUpLocator: PubMed abstract, Study Design and Results

results.measure: POP-Q point Bp ≥−2 at one year
results.note: Overall three-group comparison; graft augmentation had significantly more failures.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Study Design and Results

results.measure: PFDI-20 and PFIQ-7 prolapse, colorectal, and summary scales
results.note: Improved after surgery in all groups without between-group differences.
15% overall; no significant difference among groups. Group denominators were not reported in the abstract.
Improved in all groups without between-group differences.

harms.label: Dyspareunia
harms.note: No significant change at one year and no significant difference among groups; rates were not reported in the abstract.

delivery.label: Assessment schedule
delivery.value: Physical examination and three validated pelvic-floor instruments at baseline, six months, one year, and two years.

delivery.label: Graft technique and material
delivery.value: Site-specific rectocele repair augmented with Fortagen porcine small-intestinal-submucosa graft (Organogenesis).
